blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The capabilities of an agent swarm depend on both its individual members and how they coordinate. Yet existing multi-agent systems often train agents within fixed orchestration structures, separating the learning of individual capabilities from the organization of collective behavior. We introduce market-based post-training (MPT), a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Agents express their willingness to participate through bids, which determine who acts and how collective outcomes provide local training credit. Learning both action and bidding behavior allows individual capabilities and patterns of participation to adapt together without a central coordinating agent. We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Results show gains over monolithic post-training and confirm that agent participation indeed evolves with learning. With the same post-trained action policies, learned self-orchestration outperforms alternative coordination strategies. Ablations show that both action and bidding benefit from learning, and that learned bids provide more effective action-training signals. Beyond the original training objectives, trained swarms adapt faster to related tasks and achieve better performance with larger populations at inference time. Larger populations also suffer smaller performance losses under agent dropout, demonstrating that learned self-orchestration supports reuse, scaling, and robustness in decentralized agent swarms. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/Embodied-Minds-Lab/MPT.
blocks.zh: 代理人群的能力取决于其个别成员及其协调方式。 然而,现有的多代理系统常常在固定的管弦结构内训练代理,将个人能力的学习与集体行为的组织区分开来. 我们采用基于市场的培训后(MPT),这是在分散的代理人群中联合学习行动政策和自我约束的框架。 代理商表示愿意通过投标参与,由投标人决定谁采取行动,集体结果如何提供当地培训信贷。 学习行动和投标行为可以使个人的能力和参与模式在没有中央协调机构的情况下共同适应。 我们评估MPT的内含工艺、机器人导航和深入研究。 结果表明,在单一的后培训方面有所收获,并证实代理人的参与确实随着学习而演变。 通过同样的训练后行动政策,学会的自我管理优于其他协调战略。 差距表明,行动和投标都从学习中受益,学到的投标提供了更有效的行动培训信号。 除了最初的培训目标外,受过培训的一群人更快地适应相关任务,并在推断时间与更多的人取得更好的业绩。 较多的人口还因毒剂流失而遭受较小的性能损失,这表明在分散的毒剂群中,学得的自整能支持再利用、扩大规模和稳健性。 守则和训练有素的模型可在https://github.com/Embody-Minds-Lab/MPT上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Building general intelligence has long been a central ambition of AI research. But where does intelligence reside? A prevailing view in modern AI is model-centric: intelligence is contained in the parameters of a model, and progress comes from increasing model size or improving those parameters through training.
In this paper, we explore a different possibility. Intelligent behavior can also emerge from interactions among many simpler agents, giving rise to collective capabilities that no single agent possesses. This perspective echoes Minsky’s Society of Mind ( Minsky, 1986 ) , which explains intelligence through the organization and interaction of many individually limited components.
blocks.zh:
建立通情达理一直是AI研究的中心野心. 但情报在哪里? 现代AI中流行的观点以模型为中心:智能包含在一个模型的参数中,进步来自模型大小的增大或通过培训来改进这些参数.
在本文中,我们探索了另一种可能性。 智能行为也可能由许多更简单的代理人之间的互动而来,从而产生任何单一代理人都不具备的集体能力. 这个观点与明斯基的"心智会"(Minski)相呼应(Minski,1986年),它通过许多个别有限成分的组织和互动来解释智能.

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) agents now exhibit strong individual reasoning capabilities, yet agent swarms remain limited in their ability to organize their own participation and actions toward a shared objective. Existing multi-agent systems typically place models within predefined interaction structures: a manager delegates to workers, a verifier checks a generator, or agents communicate according to a prescribed workflow ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . Even when the participating agents are trainable, the orchestration policy that determines which agent acts next often remains fixed throughout training ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型代理人现在表现出强大的个人推理能力,但代理人群在组织自己的参与和行动以实现共同目标方面仍然有限。 现有的多剂系统通常将模型置于预先确定的相互作用结构内:管理人员代表工人,核查人员检查发电机,或代理人按照规定的工作流程进行交流(Hong等,2024;Du等,2024;Li等,2023;Wu等,2024)。 即使参与的代理人可以训练,确定下一个代理人行为的管弦政策也往往在整个训练期间保持不变(Feng等,2026年)。

blocks.en: This separation overlooks the coupling between individual capabilities and swarm orchestration. Which agent acts in a particular state shapes not only the swarm’s trajectory, but also which agents receive experience and learning signals. As agents improve, effective patterns of participation can change in turn. An agent that should act early in training may become unnecessary later; an action that was previously unhelpful may become valuable after downstream agents improve. Training individual agents under fixed orchestration therefore optimizes only one side of this coupled process. We instead ask:
blocks.zh: 这种分离忽略了个人能力和群管的结合。 哪些物剂在特定状态下作用,不仅决定了群虫的行走轨迹,也决定了哪些物剂获得经验和学习信号。 随着行动者的改进,有效的参与模式可以反过来改变。 在培训初期就应采取行动的代理人可能在以后变得没有必要;在下游代理人改善后,以前无益的行动可能变得有价值。 因此,在固定安排下培训个别代理人只能优化这一结合过程的一面。 我们却问:

blocks.en: Can decentralized agent swarms jointly learn to act and self-orchestrate from experience?
blocks.zh: 分散的代理人群能否从经验中共同学习行为和自我控制?

blocks.en: Learning self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms poses a joint orchestration and credit-assignment problem. At each turn, agents must determine who should act. When task feedback becomes available, the swarm must also determine how to train the agents whose actions shaped the trajectory. These decisions are coupled: participation determines which agents acquire experience, while learning changes which and how agents should participate in the future.
blocks.zh: 在分散的代理人群中学习自我管理造成了共同的管弦乐和信贷分配问题。 在每一回合,代理人必须确定谁应采取行动。 当得到任务反馈时,群落还必须决定如何训练其行动决定了轨迹的特工。 这些决定是相辅相成的:参与决定了哪些机构获得经验,而学习改变哪些机构以及未来应当如何参与。

blocks.en: We therefore introduce market-based post-training ( MPT ), a framework that enables decentralized agent swarms to learn both how to act and how to self-organize their participation. Following Qi et al. (2026) , agents compete for opportunities to act through bids that reflect their willingness to participate in the current decision. An economic incentive structure connects these participation decisions with credit assignment, using collective outcomes to improve both action and bidding behavior. As agents become more capable, the swarm learns when to rely on each member, allowing individual capabilities and self-orchestration to evolve together without a central coordinating agent.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了基于市场的后培训(MPT),这个框架使分散的代理人群体能够学习如何采取行动以及如何自行组织他们的参与。 继Qi等人(2026年)之后,代理商通过反映其参与当前决定的意愿的出价来争夺采取行动的机会. 经济激励结构将这些参与决定与信贷分配联系起来,利用集体结果改进行动和投标行为。 随着物剂能力增强,群虫学会了何时依赖每个成员,使得个体的能力和自律在没有中央协调物剂的情况下共同进化.

blocks.en: We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Comparisons on these benchmarks show higher training rewards than monolithic post-training, while further analysis reveals that agent participation evolves during learning. To isolate the contribution of self-orchestration, we compare coordination strategies using the same post-trained action policies. On Iron Pickaxe, MPT achieves a 63.4% relative improvement in mean episode reward over the strongest alternative, Graph-of-Agents. We further show that both bidding and action benefit from learning, with their joint use yielding the strongest performance. A credit-assignment ablation shows that learned bids also provide more effective action-training signals.
blocks.zh: 我们评估MPT的内含工艺、机器人导航和深入研究。 对这些基准的比较表明,培训的奖励高于单体的后培训,而进一步的分析表明,代理人的参与在学习过程中有所发展。 为了孤立自我管理的贡献,我们利用相同的训练后行动政策来比较协调战略。 在"铁皮克克克"(Iron Pickaxe)上,MPT比最强的"Graph-of-Agents"(Graph-Of-Agents)在平均剧集奖励上实现了63.4%的相对改善. 我们进一步表明,投标和行动都从学习中受益,它们共同使用能产生最强的业绩。 信贷分配计划表明,学到的投标也提供了更有效的行动培训信号。

blocks.en: We also examine the reusability, scalability, and robustness of MPT . Trained swarms adapt more rapidly than the single-agent baseline to new crafting objectives. Increasing the inference-time population improves pass@3 across crafting milestones without additional training, supporting the scalability of learned self-orchestration. Larger populations also better tolerate occasional agent unavailability. These results suggest that learned self-orchestration supports both reuse across objectives and flexible deployment with varying agent populations.
blocks.zh: 我们还审查MPT的可重复性、可扩展性和稳健性。 训练有素的群比单一物剂基线更快地适应新的工艺目标。 增加推论时间可以改善 " 3 " 跨越设计里程碑,而无需额外培训,支持学习的自我调整的可扩展性。 更多的人口还更好地容忍偶尔没有代理。 这些结果表明,所学的自整能既支持跨目标的再利用,也支持对不同剂种的灵活部署。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: (1) We introduce MPT , a framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms, allowing patterns of participation to adapt as agents improve.
blocks.zh: (1) 我们引入了MPT,这是一个共同学习行动政策和在分散的代理人群中自我约束的框架,允许参与模式随着代理人的改善而适应。

blocks.en: (2) We evaluate MPT on embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research, demonstrating gains over monolithic post-training. We further show the benefits of learned self-orchestration, learning both bidding and action, and using learned bids for credit assignment.
blocks.zh: (2) 我们评价MPT的内含工艺、机器人导航和深层研究,显示对单体后训练的好处。 我们进一步显示学习自我管理、学习投标和行动以及利用学习出价获得信贷的好处。

blocks.en: (3) We demonstrate the reusability, scalability, and robustness of trained agent swarms: they adapt faster to new tasks, while larger inference-time populations improve performance and robustness.
blocks.zh: (3)我们展示了训练有素的物剂群的可再用性,可伸缩性和强性:它们能更快地适应新的任务,而较大的推论时间种群则能提高性能和强性.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: We aim to jointly learn specialized action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Each agent uses its local context to decide how strongly to participate through bidding. Bids determine both which agent acts and how task rewards are allocated across participating agents for learning. We first describe this orchestration mechanism (§ 2.1 ), then explain how agents learn to act from the resulting credit (§ 2.2 ) and learn to bid through counterfactual comparisons (§ 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是共同学习专门的行动政策和在分散的代理人群中自我约束。 每个代理人都利用当地情况决定通过投标参与的程度。 投标既确定哪些代理人的行为,又确定参与的代理人如何分配任务奖励用于学习。 我们首先描述这种协调机制(第2.1节),然后解释代理人如何从所产生的信用中学习如何采取行动(第2.2节)并学会通过反事实比较来投标(第2.3节)。

blocks.en: Following Qi et al. (2026) , we adopt an auction mechanism for decentralized turn allocation. At each turn, agents independently submit bids b i b_{i} reflecting their willingness to participate in the current decision. The agent with the highest bid is selected to act, and its bid is denoted by b t b_{t} . This allows participation to depend on the agents’ local assessments without a central dispatcher. Tied bids are broken uniformly at random. If all agents bid zero, no agent acts and the turn is skipped.
blocks.zh: 继Qi等人(2026年)之后,我们采用拍卖机制进行分权转会分配。 代理商在每一回合都独立提交标书b i b_{i},反映他们愿意参加目前的决定。 出价最高的代理人被选中采取行动,其出价以bt b_{t}表示. 这使得参与可以依靠代理人在当地的评估,而无需中央调度员。 绑定的出价一律随机破解. 如果所有特工都出价为零, 就没有代理行为和转弯。

blocks.en: Bids also connect participation with credit assignment. Specifically, the selected bid b t b_{t} determines the fraction of accumulated value at turn t t that is passed backward to the preceding acting agent. Thus, a larger bid increases an agent’s opportunity to act while committing a larger share of the resulting value to earlier participation. Figure 2 illustrates how agents bid and act based on the current task state.

blocks.en: 2.3 Learning to Self-Orchestrate
blocks.zh: 2.3 学习自律

blocks.en: Figure 4: Learning to self-orchestrate through counterfactual comparisons. Starting from the same state, two alternative bids from the same agent induce different turn allocations. The alternative branch is continued from the restored state, and both branches are evaluated, producing returns that determine which bid is preferred. Preference learning then increases the relative likelihood of the bid associated with the better outcome, teaching the agent when to participate.
blocks.zh: 图4:通过反事实比较学习自律. 从同一州开始,同一代理的两个备选出价会产生不同的回合分配。 替代分支从恢复状态继续,两个分支都得到评价,产生收益,决定选择哪个出价. 然后,优先学习会增加与较好结果有关的投标的相对可能性,并教会代理人何时参加。

blocks.en: Learning to self-orchestrate requires feedback about participation: would the trajectory have improved if another agent had acted at the same turn? We obtain this feedback by comparing counterfactual rollouts from the same state, as illustrated in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 学习自我管理需要关于参与的反馈:如果另一个代理人在同一转弯时采取行动,轨迹会有所改善吗? 如图4所示,我们通过比较同一州的反事实推广来获得这种反馈。

blocks.en:
We define a turn as contested if the runner-up submits a nonzero bid. The
original branch is the collected trajectory, in which the selected agent
acts at the contested turn. To construct the alternative branch, we restore
the environment and agent states at the contested turn in a replica and
resample the selected agent’s bid up to three times until it falls below the runner-up’s bid, so that the runner-up acts instead. If no such bid is obtained, the contested turn is discarded from bidding training. The
alternative branch is then continued until the episode terminates. Each branch is scored by its sum of environment rewards from the contested turn onward. The bidding response associated with the higher-scoring branch becomes the preferred response y w y_{w} , and the other becomes the rejected response y l y_{l} . Pairs with equal branch returns are discarded.
We train the agent on these response pairs using a Bradley–Terry preference objective ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ) : ℒ bid = − log ⁡ σ ⁡ ( log ⁡ π i ​ ( y w ∣ h i , t ) − log ⁡ π i ​ ( y l ∣ h i , t ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{bid}}=-\log\sigma(\log\pi_{i}(y_{w}\mid h_{i,t})-\log\pi_{i}(y_{l}\mid h_{i,t})), (3) where σ \sigma is the logistic function. Minimizing this loss increases the relative likelihood of the bid associated with the better outcome.
We alternate between action and bidding learning during training, using four action-training steps followed by one bidding-training step.
Both updates optimize the same model parameters within each agent. This allows action competence and participation to co-adapt as learning changes the capabilities of the swarm.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments

blocks.en: 3.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate MPT on decision-making and reasoning tasks spanning embodied crafting, robot navigation, and deep research. Each setting uses three agents with complementary roles.
blocks.zh: 我们评价MPT 的决策和推理任务 包含的工艺、机器人导航和深入研究。 每个设置使用三个具有互补作用的代理.

blocks.en: Benchmarks and Models. (1) Embodied crafting : three Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct agents (Logger, Miner, and Smith) specialize in gathering wood, mining resources, and crafting. Starting from an empty inventory in Minecraft MineStudio ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , they must progress through the crafting chain to obtain an iron pickaxe. Agents receive RGB observations and textual state information, including inventory and recent interaction history. The selected agent issues a language instruction to a frozen STEVE-1 controller ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) , which executes it for 40 game frames.
blocks.zh: 基准和模式。 (1) 精巧的工艺:3个Qune3-VL-4B-指导剂(Logger、Miner和Smith)专门收集木材、采矿资源和工艺。 从Minecraft MineStudio(Cai等,2025年)的空盘开始,它们必须经过工艺链来得到铁取出. 代理接收RGB观察和文字状态信息,包括清单和近期互动历史. 被选中的代理人向被冻结的STEVE-1控制器(Lifshitz等,2023年)发布语言指令,由它为40个游戏帧执行.

blocks.en: (2) Robot navigation : three NaVILA-8B agents ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) perform continuous vision-and-language navigation on VLN-CE R2R in Habitat ( Krantz et al., 2020 ; Anderson et al., 2018 ; Savva et al., 2019 ) . Given a route instruction and an eight-frame window of egocentric observations, the agents coordinate through partitioned action spaces: Turner controls rotations, Mover controls forward movement, and Stopper decides when to stop. Episodes contain at most 64 decisions.
blocks.zh: (2)机器人导航 3个NaVILA-8B代理(Cheng等,2025年)在栖息地VLN-CE R2R上进行连续的视觉和语言导航(Krantz等,2020年;Anderson等,2018年;Savva等,2019年). 鉴于一个路径指示和一个八帧自负式观察窗口,这些代理商通过分割的动作空间进行协调: Turner控制了旋转,Morrer控制了前进运动,Stopper决定何时停止. 诗集最多包含64个决定.

blocks.en: (3) Deep research : three gemma-4-E2B-it agents ( Team et al., 2026 ) answer questions by browsing a searchable document corpus. Searcher, Opener, and Finder specialize in browser.search , browser.open , and browser.find ; all agents share the interaction history and may submit a final answer. We use OpenResearcher ( Li et al., 2026 ) for training. Episodes contain at most 64 decisions and receive a binary terminal reward based on answer correctness, assessed against the reference answer by a qwen3.5-flash judge.
blocks.zh: (3)深度研究:3个gemma-4-E2B-it代理商(Team等,2026年)通过浏览可搜索文件来回答问题. 搜索器,开源器,和Finder专攻浏览器. 搜索,浏览器.打开,浏览器.find;所有代理都共享交互历史,并可能提交最终答案. 使用OpenResearcher(Li等,2026年)进行训练. Episode包含最多64个裁决,并获得基于答案正确性的二进制终端奖励,根据qwen3.5-flash法官的参考答案进行评估.

blocks.en: Training Setup. All agents have independent model parameters and undergo a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) cold start before post-training. Each agent in MPT is fine-tuned on demonstrations corresponding to its role. We compare MPT against a monolithic REINFORCE baseline with a discount factor of γ = 0.95 \gamma=0.95 . During the SFT cold start, the baseline is trained on the combined demonstrations from all roles, with total SFT training compute matched between the two settings. Detailed task settings and hyperparameters are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 培训设置。 所有代理人都有独立的模型参数,并在训练后接受有监督的微调(SFT)冷启动. MPT的每个代理都对其作用相应的示威进行微调. 我们比较MPT与单质REINFORCE基线,折扣系数为γ=0.95\gamma=0.95. 在SFT冷起步期间,基线从所有角色对综合演示进行训练,SFT训练总数在两种设置相匹配. 附录B提供了详细的任务设置和超参数。

3.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Self-Orchestration Evolves during Training
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 自管会 培训期间的发展

blocks.en: To examine how self-orchestration develops through learning, we track agent participation on the Iron Pickaxe task across four checkpoints: after SFT but before RL, at two intermediate stages of RL, and after RL. Figure 6 plots the participation proportions of the Logger, Miner, and Smith against decision step.
blocks.zh: 为了审查自我约束如何通过学习发展,我们通过四个检查站跟踪代理人参与 " 铁皮克赛 " 任务的情况:在SFT之后但在RL之前,在RL的两个中间阶段,在RL之后。 图6列出了Logger、Miner和Smith反对决定步骤的参与比例。

blocks.en: Before RL, the Logger dominates throughout the episode, while the Miner and Smith participate infrequently. As training progresses, this pattern changes: the Logger remains predominant at early steps, but its share decreases later as the Miner and Smith become more involved. This shift becomes more pronounced after RL, with the Miner approaching the Logger’s participation level toward the end of the episode. At decision step 120, the Logger’s participation share decreases from approximately 80% before RL to 45% after RL, while the Miner’s share increases from approximately 10% to 40%. The Smith’s share also increases from approximately 10% to 15%. These observations provide behavioral evidence that the swarm adapts its allocation of acting turns during training.
blocks.zh: 在RL之前,"洛格"在整个剧集中占据了主导地位,而"米内尔"和"史密斯"则很少参与. 随着训练的进行,这种模式发生了变化:Logger在早期仍然占主导地位,但其份额会随着Miner和Smith更多地参与而减少。 这一转变在RL之后变得更加明显,而"矿工"则接近了"洛格"(Logger)的参与水平接近剧集的收尾. 在第120个决策步骤中,Logger的参与份额从RL之前的约80%下降到了RL之后的45 %,而Miner的参与份额则从约10%上升到了40 %. 史密斯公司的份额也从大约10%增加到了15%。 这些观测结果提供了行为证据,证明群在训练期间会调整其动作转弯的分出.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Comparison between Self-Orchestration and Other Coordination Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 自序战略与其他协调战略的比较

blocks.en: We evaluate whether learned self-orchestration coordinates agents more effectively than alternative inference-time strategies. We keep the post-trained action policies fixed and compare our bidding mechanism with Round-Robin ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , AgentNet ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Graph-of-Agents (GoA) ( Yun et al., 2026 ) . All configurations are evaluated on the Iron Pickaxe crafting task over the same 32 seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们评价所学的自我约束是否比其他推断时间战略更有效协调剂。 我们保留训练后的行动政策,并将我们的招标机制与Chound-Robin(Wu等,2024年),AgentNet(Yang等,2025年)和Gograph-Agents(GoA)(Yun等,2026年)进行比较。 所有配置均在同32个种子的"铁皮克克赛"(Iron Pickaxe)工艺任务上进行评估.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 (left), MPT substantially outperforms all three baselines. Specifically, MPT achieves a mean episode reward of 41.5 41.5 , compared with 25.4 25.4 for GoA, the strongest alternative coordination strategy, which corresponds to a 63.4% relative improvement. These gains demonstrate that learned self-orchestration coordinates agents more effectively.
blocks.zh: 如表2(左)所示,MPT的绩效大大超过所有三个基线。 具体来说,MPT实现了41.5 41.5的平分奖励,而GoA则为25.4 25.4,这是最强的替代协调策略,相对改善率为63.4%. 这些成果表明,学到的自我约束能更有效地协调代理人。

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Both Bidding and Action Benefit from Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 投标和行动从学习中受益

blocks.en: In this section, we show that training effectively improves both the action policy and self-orchestration. To verify this, we examine their contributions through four inference-time configurations, independently using either the initial or post-trained checkpoints for each component. We evaluate each configuration over the same 32 seeds and report mean episode reward in Table 2 .

Using post-trained checkpoints for both components yields a mean reward of 41.5, compared with 21.5 for trained bidding with initial actions and 27.2 for initial bidding with trained actions. The fully post-trained configuration achieves 2.69 times the reward of the initial configuration, which obtains 15.4. These results indicate that strong action and bidding policies are both essential for effective self-orchestration.

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Isolating the Contributions of Learned Self-Orchestration
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 孤立自学会的贡献

blocks.en: MPT differs from monolithic RL in several respects. To isolate the contribution of learned self-orchestration, we conduct two ablations on the Iron Pickaxe task. Both ablations share the same agent roles, SFT initialization, and action-training procedure as MPT , and each modifies a single component. Round-robin. Turns are allocated cyclically among the three agents, and policies are trained on the reward with a discount factor of γ = 0.95 \gamma=0.95 . This ablation removes bidding entirely. Random credit. We replace the bids used for credit assignment with random values sampled from 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{U}(0,1) , while turn allocation and bidding optimization remain unchanged. This ablation tests whether learned bids provide useful credit-assignment signals. As shown in Figure 7 , at approximately 5 × 10 18 5\times 10^{18} training FLOPs, MPT reaches a mean episode reward of about 42, compared with 15 for Round-robin, and 31 for random credit. Round-robin improves little over training. The gap to random credit shows that learned bids also provide more effective credit assignment.
blocks.zh: MPT在几个方面与单体RL不同. 为了孤立学习到的自律的贡献,我们在"铁皮克西"任务上进行了两次活活. 混合法与MPT具有相同的代理作用、SFT初始化和动作培训程序,每个程序都修改一个单一的组成部分。 圆罗宾. 转折按周期在三个代理商之间分配,对奖励政策进行培训,折扣系数为γ=0.95\gamma=0.95. 这完全取消了投标。 随机功德. 我们用从 U \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 这一减价测试了学到的出价是否提供了有用的信用分配信号。 如图7所示,在大约5×10 18 5\times 10×18}训练FLOP时,MPT达到平均剧集奖赏约42分,而回合制的奖金为15分,随机积分为31分. 轮回robin在训练上稍有改进. 随机信贷的差距表明,学到的出价也提供了更有效的信贷分配。

blocks.en: 3.4 Reusability, Scalability, and Robustness
blocks.zh: 3.4 可续用性、可伸缩性和强健性

blocks.en: To support a growing range of tasks, agent swarms need to build on previously learned skills and coordination. We investigate whether learned self-orchestration can be reused to accelerate adaptation to new objectives. We evaluate this through continual learning: starting from their Iron Pickaxe checkpoints, we continue training MPT and monolithic RL separately on two additional crafting tasks, Torch and Stone Bricks. Figure 8 reports mean episode reward against the training FLOPs.
blocks.zh: 为了支持越来越多的任务,代理人群需要利用以前学到的技能和协调。 我们调查是否可以重新利用所学的自我控制来加速适应新的目标。 我们通过不断学习来评价这一点:从他们的"铁皮克克塞"检查站开始,我们继续分别对MPT和单体RL进行另外两项工艺任务的培训,即"火炬"和"石砖". 图8报告指针对训练的FLOP的插曲奖励.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Trained swarms adapt faster to new objectives. Adaptation to (a) Torch and (b) Stone Bricks. Monolithic RL (Single) and MPT (Society) start from their respective Iron Pickaxe checkpoints and continue training separately. Curves show mean episode reward against training FLOPs.

blocks.en: The society adapts more rapidly and achieves higher rewards at comparable training FLOP budgets on both tasks. At approximately 10 18 10^{18} adaptation FLOPs, the society achieves mean episode rewards of about 35 on Torch and 38 on Stone Bricks, compared with 17 and 19 for the monolithic baseline. These results support reusing the trained agent population for efficient adaptation to new objectives.
blocks.zh: 社会更快地适应,在相当的FLOP预算培训中就这两项任务获得更高的回报. 在大约10 18 10^{18} 适应 FLOPs 上, 社会实现 平均剧集奖励 大约 35 在火炬上, 和 38 在石砖上, 相比之下, 17 和 19 的单曲基线。 这些成果有助于重新利用训练有素的代理人群体来有效地适应新的目标。

blocks.en: Decentralized agent swarms should scale at inference time. We investigate whether learned self-orchestration enables such scaling through larger agent populations. We vary the population size across 3, 6, 9, and 12 agents by using one to four copies of each trained agent. We conduct experiments on the Iron Pickaxe crafting task over 32 seeds, with three runs per seed, and evaluate pass@3 on five subtasks: Wooden Pickaxe, Stone Pickaxe, Furnace, Iron Ingot, and Iron Pickaxe. Figure 9 shows that larger populations improve performance on all subtasks. Increasing the population from 3 to 12 agents raises pass@3 from approximately 78% to 97% on Wooden Pickaxe, from 69% to 94% on Stone Pickaxe, and from 66% to 91% on Furnace. These results indicate that self-orchestration can effectively utilize additional agents to support inference-time scaling.
blocks.zh: 分散的物剂群应在推断时间扩大。 我们调查所学的自我约束是否能够使更多的毒剂数量达到这种规模。 我们通过使用每名训练有素的特工的一至四份副本来改变3、6、9和12名特工的人数。 我们在32个种子上进行"铁皮克西"的制作任务实验,每个种子有3个跑道,并在5个子任务上评价"通":"木皮克西"(Wooden Pickaxe),"石头皮克西"(Stone Pickaxe),"富尔纳克"(Furnace),"铁入"(Iron Ingot)和"铁皮克西"(Iron Pickaxe). 图9显示,更多的人口改善了所有次级任务的业绩。 将人口从3名增加到12名,使Wooden Pickaxe的通过率从78%增加到97%,Stone Pickaxe的通过率从69%增加到94%,而Furnace的通过率从66%增加到91%。 这些结果表明,自我控制可以有效地利用额外的物剂来支持推断时间的扩大。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Larger swarms improve inference-time performance. Pass@3 across five crafting milestones as the agent population increases from 3 to 12.
blocks.zh: 图 9: 较大群群提高推论时间性能. 超过@3, 跨越五个设计里程碑, 代理人口从3个增加到12个。

blocks.en: Another advantage of decentralized agent swarms is that they do not rely on a central agent. This can limit the impact of occasional agent unavailability, which becomes increasingly likely as the population grows. To evaluate this, we introduce agent dropout at inference time and measure the reward under dropout. We conduct experiments on the Iron Pickaxe task over 32 seeds, averaging three runs per seed. Figure 10 shows that larger populations can preserve more capability even under severe dropout. At a dropout probability of p = 0.9 p=0.9 , the 12-agent population maintains a mean episode reward of approximately 33, compared with 19 for the 3-agent population. These results suggest that additional agents provide redundancy that helps the swarm maintain its capabilities when members become unavailable.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLM-based multi-agent systems combine role specialization, communication, and memory to support collective behavior. Generative Agents studies emergent social interactions among agents with memory and reflection ( Park et al., 2023 ) , while CAMEL explores cooperation through role-playing ( Li et al., 2023 ) . MetaGPT and ChatDev organize software development through structured workflows and specialized roles ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) ; AutoGen and AgentVerse provide frameworks for programmable conversations and collaborative agent teams ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Multiagent debate improves reasoning through iterative exchange and revision of proposed answers ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Beyond manually specified workflows, GPTSwarm optimizes graph connectivity ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , AgentNet adapts decentralized routing through experience and evolving connections ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Graph-of-Agents selects agents and refines responses through graph-based collaboration ( Yun et al., 2026 ) .
However, these systems generally adapt interactions at inference time. MPT learns policies through weight updates, allowing agent capabilities and self-orchestration to improve together.
blocks.zh:
基于LLM的多代理系统结合了角色专业化,交流,和记忆,支持集体行为. Generative Agents研究了具有记忆和反射作用的物剂之间的新兴社会互动(Park等,2023年),而CAMEL则通过角色扮演探索合作(Li等,2023年). MetaGPT和ChatDev通过结构化的工作流程和专业角色组织软件开发(Hong等,2024;Qian等,2024;AutoGen和AgentVerse为可编程的对话和合作代理团队提供框架(Wu等,2024;Chen等,2024). 多剂辩论通过迭代交流和修改拟议答案来改进推理(Du等,2024.). 除了手动指定的工作流程外,GPTSwarm还优化了图上连接(zhuge等,2024年),AgentNet通过经验和不断发展的连接来调整分散的路由(Yang等,2025年),Graph-Agents通过图上的合作来选择代理并完善响应(Yun等,2026年).
然而,这些系统一般会在推论时间调整相互作用. MPT通过权重更新来学习政策,使代理能力和自控能力得以一起提高.

blocks.en:
Learning decentralized policies from collective feedback is a central problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning. MADDPG and MAPPO use centralized training with decentralized execution ( Lowe et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) , while VDN and QMIX factorize team value functions into agent-level utilities ( Sunehag et al., 2018 ; Rashid et al., 2020 ) . COMA addresses credit assignment through a counterfactual baseline that marginalizes one agent’s action while holding the others fixed ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) . Coordination is also learned explicitly: RIAL and DIAL learn communication protocols ( Foerster et al., 2016 ) , CommNet jointly learns continuous communication and control ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2016 ) , and IC3Net learns when agents should communicate ( Singh et al., 2019 ) . Recent work extends multi-agent training to LLMs: Multiagent Finetuning updates specialized models using their own interaction data ( Subramaniam et al., 2025 ) ; Dr. MAS stabilizes reinforcement learning through agent-wise advantage normalization ( Feng et al., 2026 ) ; and CoLLM studies centralized and decentralized critics for training decentralized LLM collaborators ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
However, these methods do not connect the choice of the next agent with how downstream reward is distributed across agents. MPT couples turn allocation and credit assignment through learned bids, using task feedback to jointly improve participation and policies.
blocks.zh:
从集体反馈中学习分散政策是多代理强化学习中的一个核心问题. MADDPG和MAPPO采用分散执行的集中培训(Lowe等,2017;Yu等,2022;而VDN和QMIX将团队价值功能纳入代理级公用事业(Sunehag等,2018;Rashid等,2020.)). 大洋协会通过一个反事实基线处理信贷转让问题,该基准将一个代理人的行动边缘化,而将其他代理人固定(Foerster等人,2018年)。 还明确学习了协调:RIAL和DIAL学习交流协议(Foerster等人,2016年),Comm。 Net联合学习了连续通信与控制(Sukhbaatar等,2016年),IC3Net学习了特工何时应进行通信(Singh等,2019年). 近期的工作将多代理培训扩大到法学硕士: 多剂精细化利用自身互动数据更新了专业模型(Subramaniam等,2025年;MAS博士通过特效优势正常化稳定了强化学习(Feng等,2026年;CoLLM研究集中和分散的批评者,以培训分散的LLM合作者(Liu等,2026年).
然而,这些方法并没有将下一个代理人的选择与下游奖励如何在代理人之间分配联系起来. MPT夫妇通过学习出价转而分配和信贷分配,利用任务反馈共同改善参与和政策。

blocks.en:
Economic coordination offers a longstanding perspective on distributed intelligence. Hayek emphasizes how prices communicate dispersed knowledge ( Hayek, 1945 ) , while Minsky describes intelligence as arising from interactions among individually limited components ( Minsky, 1986 ) . The Contract Net Protocol allocates tasks through negotiation ( Smith, 1988 ) , and market-oriented programming uses markets for decentralized resource allocation ( Wellman, 1993 ) . Economic mechanisms also connect participation to learning: Holland’s bucket brigade transfers credit along chains of active rules ( Holland, 1995 ) , and Baum’s Hayek Machine develops economic credit assignment ( Baum, 1996 ; Baum, 1999 ) . More recently, Economy of Minds uses auctions to coordinate LLM agents and guide the evolution of prompts and population with frozen model weights ( Qi et al., 2026 ) . SALE selects among agents’ proposed strategies using cost–value scoring and shared auction memory ( Alazraki et al., 2026 ) .
However, recent LLM-based economic systems primarily use feedback to evolve prompts while keeping weights frozen. MPT uses feedback to train action and bidding policies, enabling agents to learn how to act and when to participate.
blocks.zh:
经济协调为分配情报提供了一个长期的观点。 Hayek强调价格如何传播分散的知识(Hayek, 1945年),而Minski则将情报描述为个别有限成分之间的互动(Minski, 1986年). 合同网络协议通过谈判分配任务(Smith,1988年),面向市场的方案拟订利用市场进行分散的资源分配(Wellman,1993年)。 经济机制还将参与与学习联系起来: 荷兰的桶子队沿现行规则链转移信贷(荷兰,1995年),而鲍姆的哈耶克机器则发展经济信贷任务(鲍姆,1996年;鲍姆,1999年)。 最近,Economic of Minds使用拍卖来协调LLM剂,并指导有被冻结模型重量的活体和种群的演变(Qi等,2026年). 销售在代理商建议的战略中选择使用成本评分和共享拍卖记忆(Alazraki等,2026年)。
然而,最近基于LLM的经济体系主要利用反馈来演化提示,同时使权重被冻结. MPT利用反馈来培训行动和投标政策,使代理人能够学习如何行动和何时参与。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MPT , a framework for jointly learning individual action policies and self-orchestration in decentralized agent swarms. Learned bids connect participation decisions with local credit assignment, allowing agents to improve both how they act and when they participate without a central coordinating agent. Our experiments show benefits over monolithic post-training and other coordination strategies, while ablations demonstrate the value of learning both bidding and action policies and using learned bids for credit assignment. Trained swarms also adapt faster to related objectives, benefit from larger populations at inference time, and better tolerate agent unavailability as the population grows. These findings support treating self-orchestration as a learnable and reusable component of collective intelligence, opening a path toward decentralized agent swarms whose capabilities and organization improve together through experience.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MPT, 一个共同学习个人行动政策的框架, 所学出价将参与决定与当地信贷分配联系起来,使代理商能够改善他们的行为方式和在没有中央协调机构的情况下参与的情况。 我们的实验显示,单项培训后战略和其他协调战略是有好处的,而模拟则表明学习投标和行动政策以及利用学到的投标进行信贷分配的价值。 训练有素的一大批人也更快地适应相关目标,在推断时间受益于更多的人口,并且随着人口的增长,更能容忍没有代理人。 这些调查结果支持将自我约束视为集体情报中可学习和可再利用的组成部分,为分散的代理人群开辟了道路,他们的能力和组织通过经验共同提高。

blocks.en: B.1.5 SFT Cold Start
blocks.zh: B.1.5 SFT 冷起步

blocks.en: To teach the models the input and output formats and establish basic task capabilities, we perform an SFT cold start in both settings. Specifically, we use Claude Sonnet 5 to generate demonstrations of crafting-task execution and record all model responses. We collect 4,791 examples from actual Minecraft interactions, including 1,677 for Logger , 2,380 for Miner , and 734 for Smith . We fine-tune the monolithic agent on the full dataset and each society agent on its corresponding subset, matching the total training compute between the two settings during cold start. SFT for each model is performed on a single B200 GPU.
blocks.zh: 为了向模型传授输入和输出格式并确立基本的任务能力,我们在两种情况下都进行SFT冷却起步. 具体地说,我们利用克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5)来生成工艺任务执行的演示,并记录所有模型响应. 我们收集了4,791个实际Minecraft互动的例子,其中1,677个是Logger,2,380个是Miner,734个是Smith。 我们微调了完整数据集上的单质代理, 以及相应的子集上的每个社会代理, 匹配两个设置在冷启动时的总训练计算。 每个型号的SFT在单一的B200GPU上进行.

blocks.en: B.2.1 Task and Simulator
blocks.zh: B.2.1 任务和模拟器

blocks.en: The task is vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE ( Krantz et al., 2020 ) ): given a natural-language route instruction from R2R ( Anderson et al., 2018 ) , the agent must move through a photorealistic Matterport3D house ( Chang et al., 2017 ) in the Habitat simulator ( Savva et al., 2019 ) and stop within 3 m of the goal. We use the NaVILA evaluation setup ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , in which the simulator’s atomic actions are a 0.25 m forward step and a 15 ∘ turn.
blocks.zh: 任务为连续环境中的视觉与语言导航(VLN-CE (Krantz等,2020年)):由于R2R(Anderson等,2018年)的自然语言路由指令,代理机必须在人居模拟器(Savva等,2019年)中通过光现实性物质port3D室(Chang等,2017年)移动,并在目标3米以内停止. 我们使用NaVILA的评价设置(Cheng等人,2025年),其中模拟器的原子动作是0.25米前行和15分后转.

blocks.en: An episode contains at most 64 decisions. At each decision the policy receives the instruction and an eight-frame window of 512 × 512 512\times 512 egocentric RGB frames: the current frame plus seven frames sampled uniformly from the history, padded with black frames at the start of the episode. The policy answers with reasoning followed by one mid-level action, <think>...</think><act>...</act> , where the action is turn left or turn right by 15, 30 or 45 degrees, move forward by 25, 50 or 75 cm, or stop .

blocks.zh: B.2.4 代理设计

blocks.en:
The population consists of three agents, Turner , Mover and Stopper , each a separate full fine-tune of NaVILA-8B ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . They see the same frames and instruction and partition the action space: Turner owns the six turning actions, Mover the three forward moves, and Stopper the stop .
The monolithic agent is the same base model fine-tuned on the full action space.
Below, we present the prompt for the monolithic agent and the bidding and action prompts for each agent in the society.

blocks.en: B.2.5 SFT Cold Start
blocks.zh: B.2.5 SFT 冷启动

blocks.en:
To teach the models the input and output formats and establish basic navigation capability, we perform an SFT cold start in both settings. Starting from the multimodal-alignment checkpoint of NaVILA, we render oracle trajectories on R2R-CE training episodes with Habitat’s shortest-path follower. We keep successful episodes containing 1,931 decisions (800 turns, 800 moves and 331 stops), and use Claude Sonnet 5 to annotate data.
We fine-tune the monolithic agent on all data and each society agent on its own data. SFT for each model is performed on a single B200 GPU.
blocks.zh:
为了向模型传授输入和输出格式,并建立起基本的导航能力,我们在两种情况下都进行SFT冷起步. 从NaVILA的多模式对接检查站开始,我们将R2R-CE的训练节目的轨迹与生境最短的路径跟踪器相配合。 我们保留了包含1,931个决定(800个回合,800个动作和331个站)的成功剧集,并使用克洛德·索内特5来注释数据.

blocks.en: B.3.1 Task and Environment
blocks.zh: B.3.1 任务和环境

blocks.en: The task is open-domain deep research: given a question, the agent must browse a local web corpus with three tools and return a short final answer. We use the OpenResearcher benchmark ( Li et al., 2026 ) : the questions are the OpenResearcher-Dataset, and the corpus is the OpenResearcher-Corpus, served by a BM25 search service. Each question comes with one reference answer.

blocks.en:
The population consists of three agents, Searcher , Opener and Finder , each a separate full fine-tune of gemma-4-E2B-it ( Team et al., 2026 ) . They see the same conversation and partition the tool space: Searcher owns browser.search , Opener owns browser.open , and Finder owns browser.find ; any agent may end the episode by giving the final answer.
The monolithic agent is the same base model fine-tuned on turns spanning all three tools.

blocks.en: B.3.5 SFT Cold Start
blocks.zh: B.3.5 SFT 冷起步

blocks.en: To teach the models the input and output formats and establish basic browsing capability, we perform an SFT cold start in both settings. The demonstrations are the OpenResearcher-Dataset’s own browsing trajectories, produced by gpt-oss with the same three tools over the same corpus. We use 568 assistant turns, including 222 for Searcher , 273 for Opener and 73 for Finder . The monolithic agent is fine-tuned on all action turns. Each society agent is fine-tuned on the action turns it owns. SFT for each model is performed on a single H200 GPU.
blocks.zh: 为了向模型传授输入和输出格式,并建立起基本的浏览能力,我们在两种情况下都进行SFT冷起步. 由Gpt-os用相同的三个工具制作, 我们使用568个助手转弯,包括222个搜索器,273个打开器和73个查找器。 单体剂在所有动作转弯上都得到微调. 每一个社会代理人都会在行动转弯时做出微调。 每个型号的SFT在单个H200 GPU上进行.

blocks.en: We fine-tune all models in bf16 using AdamW with a cosine learning rate schedule. Detailed settings are listed in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 微调bf16中的所有模型 使用 AdamW 的同位素学习速度表。 详细设置见表5。

blocks.en: We walk through one evaluation episode of the trained population in which the society obtains the iron pickaxe. Figure 11 shows the cumulative reward over the episode; every marker is a decision that received a reward, coloured by the agent that won that decision’s auction. The chain unfolds in the order the tech tree requires: Logger gathers logs in the first decisions, Smith converts them into planks, a crafting table, sticks and a wooden pickaxe, Miner then takes over to dig down and mine cobblestone, Smith crafts the stone pickaxe and the furnace, Miner mines iron ore, and Smith smelts the ingots and crafts the iron pickaxe.

blocks.en: We walk through one episode of the society on an OpenResearcher question: “Find the country where the movie ‘Legend of the Lost’ was filmed” (reference answer: Libya ). Opener opens the Wikipedia hit, whose lead paragraph states that location shooting took place near Tripoli, Libya. blocks.en: Appendix D Potential Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 潜在限制

blocks.en: We acknowledge the following limitations:
blocks.zh: 我们承认以下局限性:

blocks.en: (1) MPT relies on externally evaluated task rewards to train both action and bidding policies. Its effectiveness depends on the quality of these signals. We have not evaluated settings where outcomes are primarily subjective or where reliable feedback is difficult to obtain.
blocks.zh: (1) MPT依靠外部评价的任务奖励来培训行动和投标政策。 其有效性取决于这些信号的质量. 我们没有评估结果主要主观或难以获得可靠反馈的环境。

blocks.en: (2) Bidding updates require counterfactual rollouts from the same environment and agent states. Therefore, extending this approach to irreversible real-world interactions remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: (2) 投标更新要求同一环境和代理状态的反事实推出。 因此,将这种方法扩大到不可逆转的现实世界互动仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: (3) Despite our efforts to broaden the experimental evaluation, computational constraints limit the scale of our study. We have not explored training swarms composed of multiple models with more than 10B parameters each, or jointly training substantially larger agent populations.
blocks.zh: (3)尽管我们努力扩大实验评价,但计算限制限制了我们的研究规模. 我们没有探索由多个模型组成的培训群,每个模型的参数都超过10B,也没有共同培训数量大得多的代理人。
